words.ex: He works in horticulture at a local garden.
words.ex_cn: 他在当地的一个花园从事园艺工作。
words.en: Horticulture is the study and practice of growing and cultivating plants, especially flowers, fruits, and vegetables.

words.ex: He likes math because it is easy.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢数学，因为它很简单。
words.en: Math is the study of numbers, quantities, and shapes.

words.ex: Farmers work hard in agriculture.
words.ex_cn: 农民在农业中辛勤工作。
words.en: The science or practice of farming, including cultivation of the soil for the growing of crops and the rearing of animals to provide food, wool, and other products.

words.ex: He wants to study engineering at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习工程。
words.en: Engineering is the work involved in designing and constructing engines and machinery, or structures such as roads and bridges. Engineering is also the subject studied by people who want to do this work.

words.ex: He loves studying geology in high school.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在高中学习地质学。
words.en: The science which deals with the physical structure and substance of the earth, their history, and the processes which act on them.

words.ex: He is an adviser to the government.
words.ex_cn: 他是政府的顾问。
words.en: An adviser is a person who gives advice, especially someone who knows a lot about a particular subject.

words.tr: n. 代理人；特工；经纪人；（药）剂；动因；
words.ex: The real estate agent helped them buy a house.
words.ex_cn: 房地产代理人帮助他们买了一所房子。
words.en: An agent is a person who acts on behalf of another person or group.

words.ex: He is an architect who designs houses.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位设计房屋的建筑师。
words.en: An architect is a person who designs buildings and advises in their construction.

words.ex: The teacher has an assistant to help with grading.
words.ex_cn: 老师有一个助理帮忙批改作业。
words.en: An assistant is a person who helps in particular work or who is under the authority of another person.

words.ex: The builder constructed a new house last month.
words.ex_cn: 这位营造商上个月建造了一栋新房子。
words.en: A builder is a person whose job is to build or repair houses and other buildings.

words.ex: The businessman sold his products to many countries.
words.ex_cn: 这位商人把他的产品卖到了许多国家。
words.en: A businessman is a man who works in business, especially at a high level.

words.tr: n. 清洁工人；清洁工具； adj. 更洁净的；更干净的；“clean”的比较级；
words.ex: The cleaner sweeps the floor every morning.
words.ex_cn: 清洁工人每天早上扫地。
words.en: A cleaner is a person whose job is to clean a place or a substance used for cleaning.

words.ex: The employee arrived at work early.
words.ex_cn: 这位雇员早早到达了工作地点。
words.en: An employee is a person who is paid to work for an organization or for another person.

words.ex: The employer gave her a raise.
words.ex_cn: 雇主给她加了薪。
words.en: An employer is a person or organization that employs people, paying them for their work.

words.ex: The instructor explained the math problem clearly.
words.ex_cn: 教员清楚地讲解了这道数学题。
words.en: An instructor is someone who teaches a skill or subject, especially in a college or university, or in a specialized field such as driving or skiing.

words.ex: The manager approved the new project.
words.ex_cn: 经理批准了新项目。
words.en: A manager is a person who is responsible for running part of or the whole of a business organization.

words.tr:
n. 官员；高级职员；
adj. 官方的；正式的；
words.ex: The official announced new rules for the festival.
words.ex_cn: 这位官员宣布了节日的新规定。
words.en: An official is a person who holds a position of authority in a government or organization, or something that is authorized or formally recognized.

words.ex: The operator answered the phone quickly.
words.ex_cn: 接线员迅速接听了电话。
words.en: An operator is a person who operates equipment or a machine, or a person who is in charge of a telephone switchboard.

words.ex: The plumber fixed the leaky pipe.
words.ex_cn: 水管工修好了漏水的管道。
words.en: A plumber is a person whose job is to connect and repair things such as water and drainage pipes, baths, and toilets.

words.tr:
adj. 专业的；职业的；
n. 专业人士；
words.ex: He is a professional teacher with many years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有多年经验的专业教师。
words.en: A professional is a person who has a job that requires special training and education, especially one that involves a high level of skill or knowledge.

words.ex: The secretary types letters for the manager.
words.ex_cn: 秘书为经理打字。
words.en: A secretary is a person whose job is to do office work, such as typing letters, answering phone calls, and arranging meetings.

words.ex: The servant cleaned the house every morning.
words.ex_cn: 仆人每天早上打扫房子。
words.en: A servant is someone who is employed to work in another person's house, doing jobs such as cooking and cleaning.

words.ex: The supervisor checked the workers' progress.
words.ex_cn: 主管检查了工人们的进展。
words.en: A supervisor is a person who oversees and directs the work of others.

words.ex: The technician fixed the broken machine.
words.ex_cn: 技术员修好了坏掉的机器。
words.en: A technician is a worker trained with special skills, especially in science or engineering.

words.ex: The zoo keeper feeds the lions every morning.
words.ex_cn: 动物园饲养员每天早上喂狮子。
words.en: A keeper is someone whose job is to look after a particular place or thing.

words.tr: n. 裁判；介绍人；仲裁者
words.ex: The referee blew the whistle for a foul.
words.ex_cn: 裁判吹哨判罚犯规。
words.en: A referee is an official who watches a game or match closely to ensure that the rules are adhered to and sometimes to arbitrate on matters arising from the play.

words.tr: n. 游泳运动员；游泳者；
words.ex: He is a fast swimmer who won the gold medal.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名速度快的游泳运动员，赢得了金牌。
words.en: A swimmer is a person who swims, especially as a sport or regularly for exercise.

words.ex: He is a specialist in heart surgery.
words.ex_cn: 他是心脏手术方面的专家。
words.en: A specialist is a person who is highly skilled or knowledgeable in a particular field.

words.ex: The painter draws a beautiful house.
words.ex_cn: 这位画家画了一座美丽的房子。
words.en: A painter is someone who paints pictures, or someone whose job is to paint surfaces such as walls and doors.

words.ex: The performer danced on stage with great energy.
words.ex_cn: 这位表演者在舞台上充满活力地跳舞。
words.en: A performer is a person who entertains an audience by acting, singing, dancing, or playing music.

words.ex: He is an apprentice in a car repair shop.
words.ex_cn: 他是汽车修理店的一名学徒。
words.en: An apprentice is a young person who works for someone in order to learn their skill.

words.ex: He completed his apprenticeship as a carpenter.
words.ex_cn: 他完成了木工学徒期。
words.en: An apprenticeship is a period of time in which someone learns a trade or profession by working under the supervision of a skilled worker.

words.ex: The biologist studies animals in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这位生物学家在森林里研究动物。
words.en: A biologist is a scientist who studies living organisms and their relationship to their environment.

words.ex: The carpenter made a wooden table.
words.ex_cn: 木匠做了一张木桌子。
words.en: A carpenter is a person whose job is making and repairing wooden objects and structures.

words.tr: n. 主席；主持人；董事长；
words.ex: The chairman called the meeting to order.
words.ex_cn: 主席宣布会议开始。
words.en: A chairman is a man who is in charge of a meeting, committee, or organization.

words.ex: He works in a clerical job at the office.
words.ex_cn: 他在办公室做文书工作。
words.en: Clerical means relating to work that is done in an office, especially work that involves keeping records or accounts. It can also refer to the clergy or the religious leaders of a church.

words.ex: The clerk at the store helped me find the book.
words.ex_cn: 商店里的职员帮我找到了那本书。
words.en: A clerk is a person whose job is to keep records or accounts in an office, shop, or bank.

words.ex: The coastguard saved a fisherman from the storm.
words.ex_cn: 海岸警卫队救了一名在风暴中的渔民。
words.en: The coastguard is a service that is responsible for protecting the coast and helping ships and boats in danger.

words.ex: She is the coordinator of the school event.
words.ex_cn: 她是学校活动的协调者。
words.en: A coordinator is someone whose job is to organize the various parts of an activity or the people involved in it so that it works efficiently.

words.tr: n. 企业家；创业者；承包人；
words.ex: He is an entrepreneur who started a small coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位创办了小型咖啡店的企业家。
words.en: An entrepreneur is a person who organizes and operates a business or businesses, taking on greater than normal financial risks in order to do so.

words.ex: The hunter caught a deer in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 猎人在森林里捕到了一只鹿。
words.en: A hunter is a person who hunts wild animals for food or as a sport.

words.ex: The interviewer asked him about his work experience.
words.ex_cn: 采访者问他关于他的工作经验。
words.en: An interviewer is a person who asks someone questions at an interview.

words.ex: The librarian helps students find books.
words.ex_cn: 图书管理员帮助学生找书。
words.en: A librarian is a person who is in charge of a library or who has been trained to do this work.

words.ex: The lifeguard saved a boy from drowning.
words.ex_cn: 救生员救了一个差点溺水的男孩。
words.en: A lifeguard is a person who is responsible for the safety of people at a beach or swimming pool, and who rescues those who are in danger of drowning.

words.tr: n. 钢琴家；钢琴弹奏者；
words.ex: The pianist played a beautiful song at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 这位钢琴家在音乐会上演奏了一首美妙的曲子。
words.en: A pianist is a person who plays the piano, especially professionally.

words.tr: n. 护林员；公园看管人；突击队员；
words.ex: The ranger walked through the forest to check for fires.
words.ex_cn: 护林员在森林里巡逻，检查是否有火灾。
words.en: A ranger is someone whose job is to look after a forest or a large park.

words.ex: The shepherd walks with his sheep every morning.
words.ex_cn: 牧羊人每天早上都带着他的羊走路。
words.en: A shepherd is a person whose job is to look after sheep. As a verb, it means to guide or direct someone or something in a particular direction.

words.ex: The warden checks the prison every morning.
words.ex_cn: 狱长每天早上检查监狱。
words.en: A warden is a person who is responsible for the supervision of a particular place or thing, or for ensuring that laws or rules are obeyed.

words.ex: The administrator fixed the computer system.
words.ex_cn: 管理人员修复了计算机系统。
words.en: An administrator is a person whose job involves helping to organize and supervise the way that an organization or institution functions.

words.ex: The chef cooked a delicious dinner for the guests.
words.ex_cn: 主厨为客人做了一顿美味的晚餐。
words.en: A chef is a professional cook, typically the chief cook in a restaurant or hotel.

words.ex: He is a composer who writes music for movies.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位为电影作曲的作曲家。
words.en: A composer is a person who writes music, especially classical music.

words.ex: He is a consultant for a big company.
words.ex_cn: 他是这家大公司的顾问。
words.en: A consultant is a person who gives expert advice to a person or organization on a particular subject.

words.ex: The designer created a new dress for the show.
words.ex_cn: 这位设计师为这场秀设计了一条新裙子。
words.en: A designer is a person who plans the form, structure, or appearance of something before it is made, by preparing drawings or plans.

words.ex: The electrician fixed the broken light.
words.ex_cn: 电工修好了坏掉的灯。
words.en: An electrician is a person whose job is to install and repair electrical equipment.

words.ex: The hairdresser cut my hair nicely.
words.ex_cn: 理发师给我剪了一头漂亮的头发。
words.en: A hairdresser is a person who cuts, colours, and arranges people's hair, especially women's, as their job.

words.ex: The journalist wrote a story about the earthquake.
words.ex_cn: 记者写了一篇关于地震的文章。
words.en: A journalist is a person whose job is to collect news and write about it for newspapers, magazines, television, or radio.

words.ex: The lecturer explains math clearly.
words.ex_cn: 这位授课老师讲解数学很清晰。
words.en: A lecturer is a person who gives lectures, especially as a profession.

words.ex: The mayor walks to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 市长每天早上步行上班。
words.en: The mayor of a town or city is the person who has been elected to represent it for a fixed period of time, or, in some places, to run its government.

words.ex: The minister signed the new law.
words.ex_cn: 部长签署了新法律。
words.en: A minister is a person who is in charge of a particular government department or a member of the clergy in some Christian churches.

words.ex: He is a musician who plays the guitar.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位弹吉他的音乐家。
words.en: A musician is a person who plays a musical instrument, especially as a profession, or is musically talented.

words.ex: The photographer took pictures of the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 这位摄影家拍了日落的照片。
words.en: A photographer is a person who takes photographs, especially as a job.

words.ex: The politician gave a speech about education.
words.ex_cn: 这位政治家就教育问题发表了一次演讲。
words.en: A politician is a person who is professionally involved in politics, especially as a holder of or a candidate for an elected office.

words.tr: n. 生产者；制造商；制片人；
words.ex: The farmer is a producer of milk.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民是牛奶的生产者。
words.en: A producer is a person or company that makes or grows things, or a person who controls and organizes the making of a film, play, or television or radio programme.

words.ex: The publisher released a new book last month.
words.ex_cn: 出版者上个月发布了一本新书。
words.en: A publisher is a person or company that prepares and issues books, journals, or music for sale.

words.ex: The receptionist greeted the visitors with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 接待员微笑着迎接了访客。
words.en: A receptionist is a person whose job is to deal with people arriving at or telephoning a hotel, office building, doctor's surgery, etc.

words.ex: The sailor fixed the rope on the boat.
words.ex_cn: 水手修理了船上的绳子。
words.en: A sailor is a person who works on a ship as a member of its crew.

words.ex: The singer sang a beautiful song at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 这位歌手在音乐会上唱了一首动听的歌。
words.en: A singer is a person who sings, especially as a profession.

words.ex: My tutor helps me with math homework.
words.ex_cn: 我的导师帮我做数学作业。
words.en: A tutor is someone who gives private lessons to one pupil or a very small group of pupils.

words.ex: The waiter brought us water and menus.
words.ex_cn: 服务员给我们端来了水和菜单。
words.en: A waiter is a man who works in a restaurant, serving people with food and drink.

words.ex: The waitress brought us water and menus.
words.ex_cn: 女服务员给我们端来了水和菜单。
words.en: A waitress is a woman who works in a restaurant, serving food and drink to customers.

words.ex: He is a writer who loves to write stories.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位喜欢写故事的作家。
words.en: A writer is a person who writes books, stories, or articles as a job or regular occupation.

words.ex: The children played in the natural park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在自然公园里玩耍。
words.en: Existing in or caused by nature; not made or caused by humankind.

words.ex: The boat is parked in the bay.
words.ex_cn: 船停在海湾里。
words.en: A bay is a body of water partially enclosed by land, typically smaller than a gulf. It can also refer to a compartment for a ship, the color of a horse, or the sound a dog makes.

words.ex: The boy found a dark cave near the hill.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在山附近发现了一个黑暗的洞穴。
words.en: A cave is a large hole in the side of a cliff or hill, or one that is under the ground.

words.ex: The hiker stood at the edge of the cliff.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者站在悬崖边上。
words.en: A cliff is a high area of rock with a very steep side, often at the edge of the sea or a river.

words.ex: The boat travels along the coastline.
words.ex_cn: 船沿着海岸线航行。
words.en: The coastline is the outline of a coast, especially its shape and appearance.

words.tr: n. 保护；节约（自然资源）；
words.ex: The park is for the conservation of wild animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园是为了保护野生动物。
words.en: The protection and preservation of the natural environment and wildlife.

words.ex: Asia is the largest continent.
words.ex_cn: 亚洲是最大的洲。
words.en: A continent is a very large area of land, such as Africa or Asia, that consists of several countries.

words.ex: The fish swim among the coral in the sea.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在海中的珊瑚间游动。
words.en: A hard stony substance secreted by certain marine coelenterates as an external skeleton, typically forming large reefs in warm seas.

words.ex: The birds sing at daylight.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在日光下歌唱。
words.en: Daylight is the natural light that comes from the sun during the day.

words.tr: n. 栖息地；居留地；产地；
words.ex: The panda's habitat is in the mountains of China.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫的栖息地在中国的山区。
words.en: The natural environment in which a species or group of species lives.

words.ex: The oak tree stands tall in the backyard.
words.ex_cn: 栎树矗立在后院。
words.en: An oak is a large tree that is common in northern countries. Oaks have strong wood and are often used for making furniture.

words.tr:
n. 高峰；顶峰；
v. 达到高峰；达到最高值；
words.ex: The mountain peak is covered with snow.
words.ex_cn: 这座山的高峰被雪覆盖。
words.en: The highest point or level of something; the pointed top of a mountain.

words.ex: The pine grows tall in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 松树在森林里长得很高。
words.en: A pine is a type of evergreen tree which has long thin leaves called needles and produces cones. As a verb, to pine means to feel a deep longing or desire for something or someone.

words.ex: The river is dirty because of pollution.
words.ex_cn: 这条河因为污染而变得肮脏。
words.en: Pollution is the process of making air, water, soil, etc. dirty and not safe or suitable to use.

words.ex: Ducks swim in the pond.
words.ex_cn: 鸭子在池塘里游泳。
words.en: A pond is a small area of water that is smaller than a lake, often artificially created.

words.tr:
n. 一系列；（变化）范围；山脉；
v. （在某范围内）变化；包括（各种不同的人或物）；
words.ex: The store offers a range of colors.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供一系列颜色。
words.en: A range of things is a number of different things of the same general kind.

words.tr:
n. 保护区；储备；保留；
v. 预订；
words.ex: The wildlife reserve is home to many endangered animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个自然保护区是许多濒危动物的家园。
words.en: If you reserve something such as a table, ticket, or magazine, you arrange for it to be kept for you and not given to anyone else.

words.tr:
n. 根；根源；
v. 生根；
words.ex: The root of 9 is 3.
words.ex_cn: 9的平方根是3。
words.en: The root of a plant is the part that grows underground and absorbs water and minerals. It can also refer to the origin or cause of something.

words.ex: He lives in a rural village with no big shops.
words.ex_cn: 他住在没有大商店的农村村庄里。
words.en: Rural areas are areas which are not towns or cities. They are often farming or agricultural areas.

words.ex: The mountain scenery is very beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 山景非常美丽。
words.en: The natural features of a landscape considered in terms of their appearance, especially when picturesque.

words.tr:
n. 种子；籽；
v. 播种；
words.ex: The farmer planted the seed in the soil.
words.ex_cn: 农夫把种子种在土里。
words.en: A seed is the small, hard part of a plant from which a new plant grows.

words.ex: The children played on the shore of the lake.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在湖岸玩耍。
words.en: The land along the edge of a sea, lake, or other large body of water.

words.ex: The solar panel collects energy from the sun.
words.ex_cn: 太阳能板从太阳收集能量。
words.en: Solar means relating to the sun or using the energy from the sun to produce electricity.

words.ex: The kettle produces steam when the water boils.
words.ex_cn: 水烧开时，水壶会产生蒸汽。
words.en: Steam is the hot mist that forms when water boils. It can be used to power machines or to cook food.

words.ex: The stream flows quietly through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 小溪静静地流过森林。
words.en: A stream is a small, narrow river. It can also refer to a continuous flow of liquid, air, or gas, or a continuous flow of data or information.

words.ex: They live in a quiet suburb outside the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在城市外一个安静的市郊。
words.en: A suburb is a residential district located on the outskirts of a city.

words.ex: We woke up early to see the sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 我们早起看日出。
words.en: The time in the morning when the sun appears or full daylight arrives.

words.ex: We watched the sunset by the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我们在海滩上看了夕阳。
words.en: The time in the evening when the sun disappears or daylight fades.

words.ex: The tide comes in every twelve hours.
words.ex_cn: 潮汐每十二小时涨一次。
words.en: The tide is the regular change in the level of the sea on the shore.

words.ex: He lives in a tropical island near the equator.
words.ex_cn: 他住在赤道附近的一个热带岛屿上。
words.en: relating to or situated in or characteristic of the tropics (the region on either side of the equator)

words.ex: The village is located in a quiet valley.
words.ex_cn: 村庄坐落在一个宁静的山谷中。
words.en: A valley is a low area of land between hills or mountains, typically with a river or stream flowing through it.

words.ex: The waterfall makes a loud sound.
words.ex_cn: 瀑布发出很大的声音。
words.en: A waterfall is a place where water flows over the edge of a steep, high cliff in hills or mountains, and falls into a pool below.

words.tr:
n. 杂草；野草；
v. 除草；铲除；
words.ex: The garden is full of weeds.
words.ex_cn: 花园里长满了杂草。
words.en: A weed is a wild plant that grows in gardens or fields of crops and is not wanted because it harms the plants that are being grown.

words.ex: The deer live in the woodland near the river.
words.ex_cn: 鹿住在河边的林地中。
words.en: An area of land covered with trees, larger than a wood.

words.ex: The atmosphere keeps the Earth warm.
words.ex_cn: 大气使地球保持温暖。
words.en: The atmosphere is the layer of gases surrounding a planet or other material body, held in place by the gravity of the body.

words.ex: He owns five acres of farmland.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有五英亩的农田。
words.en: A unit of area used in the US Customary and the British Imperial systems, equal to 4,840 square yards or 4,046.86 square meters.

words.ex: The stormy sea crashed against the rocks.
words.ex_cn: 暴风雨的海浪拍打着岩石。
words.en: Characterized by strong winds and usually rain, thunder, lightning, or snow.

words.tr:
n. 大西洋；
adj. 大西洋的；
words.ex: The ship crossed the Atlantic in ten days.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船用了十天时间穿越大西洋。
words.en: The Atlantic is the ocean that lies between the Americas to the west and Europe and Africa to the east.

words.tr:
n. （果树的）花朵；
v. 开花；
words.ex: The apple tree is full of blossom in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天时，苹果树上开满了花。
words.en: When a tree or plant blossoms, it produces flowers before producing fruit that can be eaten.

words.ex: The glacier moves slowly down the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 冰川缓慢地沿着山向下移动。
words.en: A glacier is a large, persistent body of ice that forms where the accumulation of snow exceeds its ablation over many years, often centuries.

words.ex: The birds live in a quiet marsh.
words.ex_cn: 这些鸟生活在一片宁静的沼泽中。
words.en: A marsh is an area of low-lying land which is flooded in wet seasons or at high tide, and typically remains waterlogged at all times.

words.ex: Rock contains many minerals.
words.ex_cn: 岩石中含有许多矿物。
words.en: A mineral is a solid substance that occurs naturally and has a specific chemical composition and structure.

words.ex: The poplar trees grow tall by the river.
words.ex_cn: 白杨树在河边长得很高。
words.en: A poplar is a type of tree that grows quickly and is often planted for its wood or to provide shade.

words.ex: The reservoir provides water for the nearby town.
words.ex_cn: 这个水库为附近的城镇提供水源。
words.en: A reservoir is a large quantity of a substance that is stored and can be used when needed.

words.ex: The fish swim among the seaweed near the shore.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在岸边的海藻间游动。
words.en: Seaweed is a plant that grows in the sea, especially in the ocean. It is often used in food, medicine, and cosmetics.

words.ex: The wetland is home to many birds.
words.ex_cn: 这片湿地是许多鸟类的家园。
words.en: Wetlands are areas where water covers the soil, or is present either at or near the surface of the soil all year or for varying periods of time during the year, including during the growing season.

words.ex: The willow grows near the river.
words.ex_cn: 柳树长在河边。
words.en: A willow is a type of tree with long, thin branches and narrow leaves that grows near water.

words.ex: He burns coal to keep his house warm.
words.ex_cn: 他烧煤来让房子暖和。
words.en: Coal is a hard black substance that is extracted from the ground and burned as fuel.

words.ex: She dried the herb to make tea.
words.ex_cn: 她晒干了这种药草来泡茶。
words.en: A plant or a part of a plant that is used for its medicinal, savory, or aromatic qualities.

words.ex: The store sells seasonal fruits like strawberries in spring.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店在春天出售草莓等季节性水果。
words.en: Seasonal means relating to or happening during a particular season.

words.ex: The park protects many kinds of wildlife.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园保护许多种类的野生生物。
words.en: Wildlife refers to animals and plants that live and grow in natural conditions.

words.ex: The door opens automatically when you get close.
words.ex_cn: 当你靠近时，门会自动打开。
words.en: If something happens automatically, it happens as a part of the normal process or system, without needing to be started by someone.

words.ex: The school stores student records in a database.
words.ex_cn: 学校将学生记录存储在数据库中。
words.en: A database is a collection of data that is organized so that it can easily be accessed, managed, and updated.

words.ex: He saved the file on a disk.
words.ex_cn: 他把文件保存在磁盘上。
words.en: A disk is a flat, circular object or a device used for storing digital information.

words.ex: He fixed the electrical wire with tape.
words.ex_cn: 他用胶带修好了电线。
words.en: Relating to electricity or things that use electricity.

words.ex: The town lost electricity during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴期间，这个城镇停电了。
words.en: A form of energy resulting from the existence of charged particles (such as electrons or protons), either statically as an accumulation of charge or dynamically as a current.

words.tr:
n. 闪光；一刹那；
v. 闪光；闪现；
words.ex: The camera captured a sudden flash of light.
words.ex_cn: 相机捕捉到了一道突然的闪光。
words.en: A flash is a sudden bright light that quickly disappears. As a verb, it means to shine brightly for a short time or to appear or pass suddenly.

words.ex: The doctor used a laser to fix her eye.
words.ex_cn: 医生用激光修复了她的眼睛。
words.en: A laser is a device that emits light through a process of optical amplification based on the stimulated emission of electromagnetic radiation.

words.tr:
n. 连接物；
v. 连接；联系；
words.ex: The chain has a broken link.
words.ex_cn: 这条链子有一个断了的连接物。
words.en: A link between two people, organizations, or places is a connection between them.

words.tr: n. 机械（总称）；机械装置；
words.ex: The factory uses old machinery to produce goods.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂使用旧机械来生产产品。
words.en: Machinery refers to machines in general or the parts of a machine that make it work.

words.ex: He spoke into the microphone to be heard clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他对着麦克风说话，以便被清楚地听到。
words.en: A microphone is a device that is used to make sounds louder or to record them.

words.ex: The internet is a big network of computers.
words.ex_cn: 互联网是一个庞大的计算机网络。
words.en: A network is a system of lines or channels that cross or connect, or a group of broadcasting stations that connect for the simultaneous broadcast of a program.

words.ex: The printer is out of paper.
words.ex_cn: 打印机没有纸了。
words.en: A printer is a machine that can be connected to a computer in order to make copies on paper of documents or other information held by the computer.

words.ex: The satellite sends pictures from space.
words.ex_cn: 卫星从太空发送图片。
words.en: A satellite is an object which has been sent into space in order to collect information or to be part of a communications system. Satellites move continually round the earth or around another planet.

words.ex: He uses software to write his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他使用软件写作业。
words.en: Software refers to the programs and other operating information used by a computer.

words.ex: He looks at the stars through a telescope.
words.ex_cn: 他通过望远镜看星星。
words.en: A telescope is an optical instrument designed to make distant objects appear nearer, containing an arrangement of lenses, or of curved mirrors and lenses, by which rays of light are collected and focused and the resulting image magnified.

words.ex: The mechanical toy moves with batteries.
words.ex_cn: 这个机械玩具用电池驱动。
words.en: Relating to machines or machinery; operated by or involving a machine or machines.

words.ex: He works in a technical department.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个技术部门工作。
words.en: Technical means involving the sorts of machines, processes, and materials that are used in industry, transport, and communications.

words.ex: The children were exposed to cold weather without coats.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在没有外套的情况下遭受了寒冷天气。
words.en: To expose something means to uncover it so that it can be seen, or to make it known or public.

words.tr:
v. 弄懂；认为；
n. 数字；重要或有名的人物；
words.ex: I couldn't figure out why he was late.
words.ex_cn: 我弄不懂他为什么迟到。
words.en: A figure is a number, a person, a shape, or a form. It can also refer to the process of calculating or appearing in a particular way.

words.ex: The company will advertise its new phone on TV.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司将在电视上为新手机登广告。
words.en: If you advertise something such as a product, an event, or a job, you tell people about it in newspapers, on television, or on posters in order to encourage them to buy the product, go to the event, or apply for the job.

words.ex: This book has three editions.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有三个版次。
words.en: An edition is a particular version of a book, magazine, or newspaper that is printed at one time.

words.tr:
n. 照片；相片；
v. 拍照；
words.ex: He showed me a photograph of his dog.
words.ex_cn: 他给我看了他狗的照片。
words.en: A photograph is a picture that is made using a camera.

words.ex: He loves photography and takes pictures every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱摄影，每个周末都拍照。
words.en: Photography is the art, application, and practice of creating durable images by recording light or other electromagnetic radiation, either electronically by means of an image sensor, or chemically by means of a light-sensitive material such as photographic film.

words.ex: The audio signal was clear and loud.
words.ex_cn: 音频信号清晰响亮。
words.en: Audio refers to sound, especially when recorded, transmitted, or reproduced.

words.ex: The school uses computerised tests for math.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校使用计算机化的数学测试。
words.en: Made to operate by or through the use of computers; automated.

words.tr: n. 计算机操作；计算； v. “compute”的现在分词；
words.ex: Computing helps us solve math problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 计算机操作帮助我们快速解决数学问题。
words.en: Computing is the activity of using computers and writing programs for them.

words.tr:
adj. 多媒体的；
n. 多媒体；
words.ex: The school uses multimedia tools to teach students.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校使用多媒体工具来教学。
words.en: Multimedia is the use of computers to present text, graphics, video, animation, and sound in an integrated way.

words.ex: He listens to a podcast every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上听播客。
words.en: A podcast is a digital audio file made available on the internet for downloading to a computer or mobile device, typically available as a series, new installments of which can be received by subscribers automatically.

words.ex: The hotel offers free wifi for guests.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店为客人提供免费无线网络。
words.en: A technology that allows electronic devices to connect to a wireless local area network (WLAN).

words.ex: He writes a blog about travel.
words.ex_cn: 他写一个关于旅行的博客。
words.en: A blog is a website containing a writer's or group of writers' own experiences, observations, opinions, etc., and often having images and links to other websites.

words.tr: n. 时事通讯；业务通讯；简报
words.ex: He reads the weekly newsletter every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周一都读这份周刊。
words.en: A newsletter is a regularly distributed publication that is generally about one main topic of interest to its subscribers.

words.ex: He works in a small studio near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他在公园附近的一个小工作室工作。
words.en: A studio is a room where an artist, photographer, or designer works, or a place where movies or television programs are made.

words.ex: He picked up the telephone to call his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起电话给妈妈打电话。
words.en: A telephone is a device that you use to speak to someone in another place by dialing a number. It converts sound into electrical signals that can be sent over long distances.

words.ex: He cannot breathe when he runs fast.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得快时无法呼吸。
words.en: To breathe means to take air into your lungs and then expel it, a process necessary for life.

words.ex: He was conscious after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故后他醒了过来。
words.en: If you are conscious of something, you notice it or are aware of it.

words.tr: adj. 残疾的； v. “disable”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The disabled man uses a wheelchair to move around.
words.ex_cn: 这位残疾人使用轮椅行动。
words.en: If someone is disabled, they are unable to use part of their body or mind properly, for example, because of injury or illness.

words.ex: Regular exercise improves your fitness.
words.ex_cn: 规律锻炼能改善你的健康。
words.en: The condition of being physically fit and healthy.

words.ex: He has a gene that makes him tall.
words.ex_cn: 他有一个让他长高的基因。
words.en: A gene is the basic physical and functional unit of heredity. Genes, which are made up of DNA, act as instructions to make molecules called proteins.

words.ex: He got an injury while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时受了伤。
words.en: An injury is damage to your body. It is a general term that refers to harm caused by accidents, falls, hits, weapons, etc.

words.tr: v. 恢复；重新获得；复原；
words.ex: He will recover from the illness soon.
words.ex_cn: 他很快就会从疾病中恢复。
words.en: If you recover from an illness or an injury, you become well again. If you recover something that has been lost or stolen, you find it or get it back.

words.ex: He stayed home because of sickness.
words.ex_cn: 他因为生病待在家里。
words.en: A particular illness or disease.

words.ex: He needs surgery for his broken arm.
words.ex_cn: 他需要做手术来治疗断掉的胳膊。
words.en: Surgery is the medical specialty that uses operative manual and instrumental techniques on a patient to investigate or treat a pathological condition such as a disease or injury, to help improve bodily function or appearance, or to repair unwanted ruptured areas.

words.ex: He has a high fever as a symptom of the flu.
words.ex_cn: 他发烧是流感的症状。
words.en: A symptom is a physical or mental feature which is regarded as indicating a condition of disease, particularly such a feature that is apparent to the patient.

words.tr: n. 平板电脑；（刻有文字的）匾；
words.ex: He uses a tablet to read books.
words.ex_cn: 他用平板电脑读书。
words.en: A tablet is a small, flat computer that is controlled by touching the screen. It can also refer to a small, solid piece of medicine that you swallow.

words.ex: He is receiving therapy for his back pain.
words.ex_cn: 他正在接受治疗以缓解背痛。
words.en: Therapy is the treatment of someone with mental or physical illness without the use of drugs or operations.

words.ex: He is allergic to peanuts.
words.ex_cn: 他对花生过敏。
words.en: If you are allergic to something, you become ill or get a rash when you eat it, smell it, or touch it.

words.ex: He has an allergy to peanuts.
words.ex_cn: 他对花生过敏。
words.en: An allergy is a condition in which your immune system reacts abnormally to a foreign substance.

words.ex: He has asthma and cannot run fast.
words.ex_cn: 他有哮喘，不能跑快。
words.en: A respiratory condition marked by spasms in the bronchi of the lungs, causing difficulty in breathing. It usually results from an allergic reaction or other forms of hypersensitivity.

words.ex: The cardiac patient needs to rest daily.
words.ex_cn: 这位心脏病人需要每天休息。
words.en: Cardiac means relating to the heart.

words.ex: He got frostbite on his fingers after playing in the snow too long.
words.ex_cn: 他在雪地里玩太久，手指冻伤了。
words.en: Frostbite is an injury caused by freezing of the skin and underlying tissues.

words.ex: The government wants to improve healthcare for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 政府希望为所有人改善医疗保健。
words.en: Healthcare refers to the organized provision of medical care to individuals or a community.

words.ex: He gave his mother a massage after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后给妈妈做了按摩。
words.en: The act of rubbing and pressing someone's body with the hands to reduce tension or pain in the muscles.

words.tr: n. 护理（工作）；护理行业； v. “nurse”的现在分词；
words.ex: She works in nursing at the local hospital.
words.ex_cn: 她在当地医院从事护理工作。
words.en: The profession or practice of providing care for the sick and infirm.

words.tr: n. 矿泉疗养地；矿泉城；水疗中心；
words.ex: They went to the spa to relax and drink mineral water.
words.ex_cn: 他们去矿泉疗养地放松并饮用矿泉水。
words.en: A spa is a place where people go to improve their health and relax by having treatments such as massages and facials, and by exercising and swimming.

words.ex: He went to the clinic for a check-up.
words.ex_cn: 他去诊所做检查。
words.en: A clinic is a place where people receive medical treatment or advice, especially for a particular illness or condition.

words.ex: He injured his leg while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了腿。
words.en: To injure someone means to cause them physical harm, for example in an accident or an attack.

words.tr: n. 药物；药物治疗；药物处理；
words.ex: He took his medication every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃药。
words.en: Medication refers to a substance used for medical treatment, especially a medicine or drug.

words.ex: Eating vegetables gives you good nutrition.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜能提供良好的营养。
words.en: The process of providing or obtaining the food necessary for health and growth.

words.ex: This food has good nutritional value.
words.ex_cn: 这种食物有很好的营养价值。
words.en: Relating to the process of providing or obtaining the food necessary for health and growth.

words.tr:
v. 补充；
n. 补充物；附加费；
words.ex: He supplements his income by teaching part-time.
words.ex_cn: 他通过兼职教学来补充收入。
words.en: A supplement is something that is added to something else in order to make it complete or better.

words.ex: Eating fruits gives you vitamin C.
words.ex_cn: 吃水果可以给你维生素C。
words.en: A vitamin is one of a group of organic substances which are essential in small quantities to the nutrition of most animals and some plants, and which are present in natural foodstuffs or sometimes produced within the body.

words.ex: He uses a wheelchair to move around.
words.ex_cn: 他使用轮椅来移动。
words.en: A wheelchair is a chair with wheels, used by people who cannot walk because of illness, injury, or disability.

words.ex: The farmer feeds his cattle every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天早上喂他的牛。
words.en: Cattle are large domesticated animals that are kept on farms for their milk or meat.

words.ex: The creature lived in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这个生物生活在森林里。
words.en: A creature is a living thing, especially an animal.

words.ex: A deer is walking in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 一只鹿正在森林里走路。
words.en: A deer is a large wild animal that eats grass and leaves. The male has antlers that are shed and regrown each year.

words.ex: The child loves to watch dinosaurs on TV.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子喜欢在电视上看恐龙。
words.en: A dinosaur is a type of reptile that lived millions of years ago, known for its large size and often extinct species.

words.ex: The dolphin jumped high out of the water.
words.ex_cn: 海豚从水中高高跳起。
words.en: A dolphin is a marine mammal that is known for its intelligence and friendly nature towards humans.

words.ex: The donkey carries water on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 这头驴在山上驮水。
words.en: A donkey is a four-legged animal related to the horse, but smaller and with longer ears. Donkeys are often used for carrying or pulling things, especially in parts of the world where there are no cars or trucks.

words.ex: The frog jumps over the pond.
words.ex_cn: 青蛙跳过池塘。
words.en: A frog is a small creature with smooth skin, big eyes, and long back legs, which it uses for jumping. Frogs live in or near water.

words.ex: The coat is made of soft fur.
words.ex_cn: 这件外套是由柔软的毛皮制成的。
words.en: The thick hair that covers the bodies of some animals, or the hair-covered skin(s) of animals, used in making clothes and other items.

words.ex: The goat eats grass in the field.
words.ex_cn: 山羊在田野里吃草。
words.en: A goat is a farm animal or a wild animal that is about the size of a sheep. Goats have horns, and some have long hair.

words.tr:
n. 窝；鸟巢；
v. 筑巢；
words.ex: The bird built a nest in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 鸟在树上筑了一个窝。
words.en: A nest is a structure made by a bird for laying eggs and sheltering its young. It can also refer to a place where insects or other animals lay eggs or raise their young. As a verb, to nest means to build or use a nest.

words.tr: n. 掠夺者；捕食性动物；食肉动物；
words.ex: The lion is a predator that hunts deer.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是一种捕食鹿的掠夺者。
words.en: A predator is an animal that naturally preys on others.

words.ex: A snake is a reptile.
words.ex_cn: 蛇是一种爬行动物。
words.en: A reptile is a cold-blooded vertebrate of the class Reptilia, including snakes, lizards, crocodiles, turtles, and tortoises. They are characterized by their scaly skin and the fact that they lay eggs on land.

words.ex: A white swan swam quietly on the lake.
words.ex_cn: 一只白天鹅静静地在湖上游泳。
words.en: A swan is a large, white bird with a long neck that lives on rivers and lakes.

words.ex: The falcon flew high above the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 猎鹰在群山上空飞翔。
words.en: A falcon is a bird of prey, known for its speed and keen eyesight, used in falconry.

words.ex: The fish swam fast using its fin.
words.ex_cn: 鱼用它的鳍快速游动。
words.en: A fin is a thin flat part that sticks out from the body of a fish, used for swimming and balancing.

words.ex: The geese flew south for winter.
words.ex_cn: 这些鹅飞往南方过冬。
words.en: Geese are waterfowl belonging to the family Anatidae, which also includes ducks and swans. They are known for their migratory habits and their distinctive honking sound.

words.ex: The greyhound runs very fast in the race.
words.ex_cn: 这只灵缇犬在比赛中跑得非常快。
words.en: A greyhound is a breed of dog known for its speed and used in racing.

words.ex: A hawk flew over the field.
words.ex_cn: 一只鹰飞过田野。
words.en: A hawk is a bird of prey with a strong beak and sharp claws, known for its keen vision and swift flight. As a verb, to hawk means to sell goods aggressively, often in public places.

words.ex: The kingfisher dives into the river to catch fish.
words.ex_cn: 翠鸟飞入河中抓鱼。
words.en: A kingfisher is a brightly colored bird with a large head and long sharp beak, that lives near rivers and lakes and eats fish.

words.ex: The lizard sits on the rock in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 蜥蜴趴在阳光下的石头上。
words.en: A lizard is a reptile with a long body, four legs, a long tail, and rough, scaly skin.

words.ex: A moth flew into the room through the window.
words.ex_cn: 一只蛾子从窗户飞进了房间。
words.en: A moth is an insect with wings that is related to the butterfly. Moths are often attracted to light and are mostly active at night.

words.ex: Birds begin nesting in spring.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类在春天开始筑巢。
words.en: The process by which birds build or occupy nests.

words.ex: He is allergic to shellfish.
words.ex_cn: 他对贝类过敏。
words.en: Shellfish are sea creatures that live in shells and are eaten as food.

words.ex: The squirrel ran up the tree with a nut.
words.ex_cn: 松鼠带着一颗坚果跑上了树。
words.en: A squirrel is a small animal with a bushy tail that lives in trees and is known for its ability to climb and jump.

words.ex: The farmer feeds the lamb every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天早上喂羔羊。
words.en: A lamb is a young sheep.

words.tr: n. 鲑鱼；三文鱼；大马哈鱼；
words.ex: He grilled salmon for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他烤了鲑鱼当晚餐。
words.en: A salmon is a large silver-coloured fish which lives in the sea and rivers.

words.ex: There is a clear relation between exercise and health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼与健康之间有明显的关联。
words.en: A relation between two things is a connection or link between them.

words.tr:
n. 双胞胎之一；
adj. 成对的；
words.ex: He has a twin brother who looks exactly like him.
words.ex_cn: 他有一个和他长得一模一样的双胞胎兄弟。
words.en: One of two children or animals born at the same birth; to pair or match closely.

words.ex: The elderly man walks slowly with a cane.
words.ex_cn: 这位年老的男子拄着拐杖慢慢走。
words.en: An elderly person is someone who is old or aging.

words.ex: That guy is waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 那个家伙正在等公交车。
words.en: A guy is a man or boy. You can refer to a group of people, especially men or boys, as guys.

words.tr: n. （十三到十九岁的）青少年
words.ex: The teenager walks to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个青少年每天步行上学。
words.en: A teenager is someone who is between thirteen and nineteen years old.

words.ex: The school decided to adopt a new teaching method.
words.ex_cn: 学校决定采纳一种新的教学方法。
words.en: To adopt means to take up or start to use or follow (an idea, method, or course of action). It can also mean to legally take another's child and bring it up as one's own.

words.ex: The old man is the guardian of his grandchildren.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人是他的孙子孙女的保护人。
words.en: A guardian is someone who has the legal authority and responsibility to take care of someone else, especially a child whose parents have died.

words.ex: I live with a local family during my homestay.
words.ex_cn: 我在寄宿家庭期间和一个当地家庭住在一起。
words.en: A homestay is a form of tourism and/or study abroad program that allows the visitor to rent a room from a local family to better learn the local lifestyle as well as improve their language ability.

words.tr:
n. 母亲身份；
adj. 产妇的；
words.ex: She enjoys her maternity after giving birth to her first child.
words.ex_cn: 她在生下第一个孩子后享受做母亲的身份。
words.en: Maternity refers to the state of being a mother or the period during which a woman is pregnant or has recently given birth.

words.ex: Parental love is very important for children.
words.ex_cn: 父母的爱对孩子非常重要。
words.en: Relating to or characteristic of a parent or parents.

words.tr:
adj. 女性的；雌性的；
n. 雌性；女性；
words.ex: The female teacher is very kind.
words.ex_cn: 这位女老师非常和蔼。
words.en: A female is a person or animal that belongs to the sex that can have babies or produce eggs.

words.ex: His surname is Smith.
words.ex_cn: 他的姓是史密斯。
words.en: Your surname is the name that you share with other members of your family. In English-speaking countries and many other countries, it is your last name.

words.ex: The toddler is walking slowly by the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 这个幼儿正慢慢地在沙发旁走路。
words.en: A toddler is a young child who has just learned to walk or who is learning to walk.

words.ex: The dog buried a bone in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 狗把一根骨头埋在了花园里。
words.en: The hard, rigid form of connective tissue constituting most of the skeleton of vertebrates, composed chiefly of calcium salts.

words.ex: He rubbed his chest after the cough.
words.ex_cn: 他咳嗽后揉了揉胸部。
words.en: The front part of a person's body between the neck and the stomach, or a large strong box used for storing things.

words.ex: He rubbed his chin when he thought.
words.ex_cn: 他思考时摸了摸下巴。
words.en: The part of the face below the mouth and above the neck.

words.ex: He clenched his fist when he got angry.
words.ex_cn: 他生气时握紧了拳头。
words.en: A hand with the fingers clenched in the palm, typically in order to strike a blow or grasp something.

words.ex: He stepped on my heel by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心踩到了我的脚后跟。
words.en: The heel is the back part of the foot, below the ankle. It can also refer to the part of a shoe or boot that supports this part of the foot.

words.tr: n. 一圈；（人坐着时）大腿部；
words.ex: He ran three laps around the track.
words.ex_cn: 他在跑道上跑了三圈。
words.en: The upper part of the legs of a seated person; a single turn or round in a race or other competition.

words.ex: The palm tree grows near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 棕榈树长在海滩附近。
words.en: The inner surface of the hand that extends from the wrist to the base of the fingers; also refers to the tropical tree with large divided leaves.

words.ex: The boy hurt his spine when he fell from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 他从树上摔下来时伤到了脊柱。
words.en: The spine is the row of bones down the center of your back that supports your body and protects your spinal cord.

words.ex: He gave a thumbs-up with his thumb.
words.ex_cn: 他用大拇指比了个赞。
words.en: The thick short digit on the hand that is opposite to the fingers and can be moved to be opposite any of the other fingers.

words.ex: He measured his waist with a tape.
words.ex_cn: 他用卷尺测量了自己的腰围。
words.en: Your waist is the middle part of your body where it narrows slightly above your hips.

words.tr: n. 一个特殊日子的前夕或前夜
words.ex: The eve of Christmas is very special.
words.ex_cn: 圣诞节前夜非常特别。
words.en: The period of time immediately before an event or occasion, especially the day before a holiday or festival.

words.ex: We had dinner, and afterwards we went for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 我们吃了晚饭，后来去散步了。
words.en: If you do something or if something happens afterwards, you do it or it happens after a particular event or time that has already been mentioned.

words.ex: She is currently working at a hospital.
words.ex_cn: 她目前正在一家医院工作。
words.en: at the present time

words.ex: He waited for hours, and eventually got his turn.
words.ex_cn: 他等了几个小时，终于轮到他了。
words.en: At an unspecified later time; in the end.

words.ex: He visits his grandparents every fortnight.
words.ex_cn: 他每两周拜访一次祖父母。
words.en: A fortnight is a period of two weeks.

words.ex: I will go to the park on Friday.
words.ex_cn: 我将在星期五去公园。
words.en: Friday is the day of the week between Thursday and Saturday.

words.ex: He left the room immediately after the bell rang.
words.ex_cn: 铃声一响，他就立即离开了房间。
words.en: If something happens immediately, it happens without any delay.

words.ex: We eat lunch at midday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在中午吃午饭。
words.en: Midday is the middle part of the day, from noon until early afternoon.

words.ex: The clock struck midnight.
words.ex_cn: 钟敲响了午夜。
words.en: Midnight is twelve o'clock in the middle of the night.

words.ex: I have a meeting on Monday.
words.ex_cn: 我星期一有个会议。
words.en: Monday is the day of the week between Sunday and Tuesday.

words.ex: Nowadays, many children use tablets to learn.
words.ex_cn: 现在，许多孩子用平板电脑学习。
words.en: At the present time, in contrast with the past.

words.ex: I have a meeting on Thursday.
words.ex_cn: 我星期四有一个会议。
words.en: Thursday is the day of the week between Wednesday and Friday.

words.ex: I have a meeting on Wednesday.
words.ex_cn: 我在星期三有一个会议。
words.en: Wednesday is the day of the week that comes after Tuesday and before Thursday.

words.ex: The blond man smiled at the children.
words.ex_cn: 那个白肤金发的男子对孩子们微笑了。
words.en: If someone has blond hair, it is pale yellow in color.

words.tr: adj. 带…色的；有色的； v. “color”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The sky turned coloured with orange and pink at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 日落时，天空呈现出橙色和粉色。
words.en: Coloured is used to describe something that has color or is not black and white.

words.tr: n. 预订； v. 预订；“book”的现在分词；
words.ex: I made a booking for a hotel room.
words.ex_cn: 我预订了一间酒店房间。
words.en: The act of reserving accommodations, travel arrangements, tickets, etc., in advance.

words.ex: He bought a guidebook for his trip to Paris.
words.ex_cn: 他为去巴黎旅行买了一本旅游指南。
words.en: A guidebook is a book that gives tourists information about a town, area, or country.

words.ex: I made a reservation for two at the restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我在餐厅预订了两个人的座位。
words.en: A reservation is an arrangement whereby something, especially a seat or room, is kept for a particular person who will arrive later.

words.ex: I bought a souvenir from the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我从海边买了一个纪念品。
words.en: A souvenir is something which you buy or keep to remind you of a holiday, place, or event.

words.ex: He buys a novel at the bookshop.
words.ex_cn: 他在书店买了一本小说。
words.en: A shop where books are sold.

words.tr:
n. 购买；采购；
v. 购买；采购；
words.ex: The purchase of a new car took all his savings.
words.ex_cn: 买一辆新车花光了他所有的积蓄。
words.en: To purchase something means to buy it. It can also refer to something that has been bought.

words.ex: I went shopping for groceries yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天去购物买杂货了。
words.en: The activity of buying things from shops.

words.tr:
v. 鼓掌；拍手
n. 鼓掌；拍手
words.ex: The crowd will clap after the song.
words.ex_cn: 歌曲结束后，观众会鼓掌。
words.en: To clap means to strike the palms of your hands together to show appreciation or to make a noise.

words.tr:
n. 常规；例行公事；
adj. 常规的；例行公事的；
words.ex: He follows a morning routine every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都遵循固定的惯例。
words.en: A routine is a sequence of actions regularly followed; a fixed program.

words.tr: n. 吸烟；抽烟； v. 冒烟；“smoke”的现在分词；
words.ex: Smoking is bad for your health.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对健康有害。
words.en: The act of inhaling and exhaling the smoke of tobacco or a drug.

words.ex: My parents give me a weekly allowance.
words.ex_cn: 我父母每周给我零用钱。
words.en: An allowance is money that is given regularly, usually to a child, by their parents, or by the government to someone who is unemployed or ill.

words.ex: He paid with a cheque yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天用支票付款了。
words.en: A written order to a bank to pay a specified sum from someone's account.

words.ex: The expense of the trip was higher than expected.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅行的费用比预期的要高。
words.en: An expense is the amount of money that you spend on something.

words.ex: He paid the fee to join the club.
words.ex_cn: 他支付了加入俱乐部的费用。
words.en: A fee is a sum of money that you pay to be allowed to do something such as join an organization, or to be given advice or a service.

words.ex: He bought insurance for his car.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的车买了保险。
words.en: Insurance is an arrangement in which you pay money to a company, and they pay money to you if something unpleasant happens to you, for example if your property is stolen or damaged, or if you get a serious illness.

words.ex: The bank gave a loan to the student.
words.ex_cn: 银行向学生提供了一笔贷款。
words.en: A loan is a sum of money that you borrow.

words.ex: He made the payment online.
words.ex_cn: 他在线支付了。
words.en: A payment is an amount of money that is paid to someone, or the act of paying this money.

words.ex: He found a penny on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 他在地上发现了一便士。
words.en: A penny is a small unit of currency used in the United Kingdom and the United States. In the UK, it is the smallest denomination of the pound sterling, and in the US, it is a cent, the smallest denomination of the dollar.

words.tr: v. 租借；出租；“rend”的过去式和过去分词； n. 租金；
words.ex: They rent a small apartment in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们租了一间城市里的小公寓。
words.en: Rent refers to the payment made periodically by a tenant to a landlord for the use of property or land.

words.tr:
n. 金额；总数；
v. 概括；
words.ex: The sum of the bill is fifty dollars.
words.ex_cn: 账单的金额是五十美元。
words.en: A sum is an amount of money, or the total amount of two or more amounts of money added together.

words.ex: He withdrew $100 from the ATM.
words.ex_cn: 他从自动取款机里提取了100美元。
words.en: If you withdraw something from a place, you remove it or take it away.

words.ex: She bought some cloth to make a dress.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一些布来做裙子。
words.en: Cloth is fabric which is made by weaving or knitting cotton, wool, silk, or other threads. Cloth is used especially for making clothes.

words.tr:
n. 钩；挂钩；
v. 钩住；
words.ex: The key hung on a metal hook.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙挂在金属钩上。
words.en: A hook is a bent piece of metal or plastic that is used for catching or holding things, or for hanging things on.

words.ex: The bridge is made of iron.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥是用铁建造的。
words.en: Iron is a strong hard metal that is used to make steel and is also found in small quantities in blood and food.

words.ex: He climbed the ladder to fix the roof.
words.ex_cn: 他爬梯子去修屋顶。
words.en: A ladder is a piece of equipment consisting of a series of steps or rungs fixed between two upright lengths of wood, metal, or rope, used for climbing up or down something.

words.ex: We had a barbecue in the park last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们在公园举行了户外烧烤。
words.en: A barbecue is a meal or gathering at which meat, fish, or other food is cooked out of doors on a rack over an open fire or on a special appliance.

words.tr: n. 进入；入口；条目；参与；参赛作品；
words.ex: The entry to the building is locked after 10 PM.
words.ex_cn: 建筑物在晚上10点后进入通道会被锁上。
words.en: An entry is the act of going into a place or the right to go into it. It can also refer to a door, gate, or passage by which you enter a place. Additionally, an entry can be a piece of information recorded in a book, list, or computer, or the act of recording it.

words.ex: He put the letter in an envelope.
words.ex_cn: 他把信装进了一个信封。
words.en: An envelope is a flat, usually rectangular or square, paper container for a letter, which you seal before you send it by post.

words.ex: She sewed a button on her coat.
words.ex_cn: 她把一颗纽扣缝在了外套上。
words.en: A button is a small, usually round object that you press to operate a device or a machine, or a small, round object that you fasten to clothing to keep it closed.

words.tr: adj. 随意的；非正式的；偶然的；
words.ex: He wore casual clothes to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了随意的衣服去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone's attitude or behavior as casual, you mean they are not very concerned about what they are doing or what is happening around them, or they are not taking it seriously.

words.ex: He bought new clothing for the winter.
words.ex_cn: 他为冬天买了新衣服。
words.en: Clothing refers to items worn on the body. Clothing is typically made of fabrics or textiles but over time has included garments made from animal skin or other thin sheets of materials put together.

words.ex: He wore a funny costume for the party.
words.ex_cn: 他为派对穿了一套滑稽的服装。
words.en: A costume is a set of clothes in a style typical of a particular country or historical period, or a set of clothes worn by an actor for a particular role.

words.ex: He wears a helmet when he rides a bike.
words.ex_cn: 他骑自行车时戴头盔。
words.en: A helmet is a strong, hard hat which is worn to protect your head.

words.ex: She wore beautiful jewellery to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她戴了漂亮的珠宝去参加派对。
words.en: Jewellery consists of objects that are worn for personal adornment, such as bracelets, rings, necklaces, and earrings, often made from precious metals and gemstones.

words.ex: She wore sandals to the beach.
words.ex_cn: 她穿着凉鞋去海滩。
words.en: A sandal is a type of light shoe that you wear in warm weather, which has straps that go over your foot and around your ankle.

words.ex: The trainer helped the athlete improve his speed.
words.ex_cn: 训练者帮助运动员提高了他的速度。
words.en: A trainer is someone who teaches skills to people or animals and prepares them for a job, activity, or sport.

words.ex: He flipped through the album with old photos.
words.ex_cn: 他翻看着装满旧照片的相册。
words.en: An album is a collection of several pieces of music, songs, or photographs that are intended to form a single item.

words.ex: The cat ran down the alley.
words.ex_cn: 猫跑进了小巷。
words.en: An alley is a narrow passage between buildings or other structures.

words.ex: He bought a hot dog from a food booth.
words.ex_cn: 他从一个小吃亭买了个热狗。
words.en: A booth is a small area separated from a larger public area by screens or thin walls where, for example, people can make a phone call or vote in private.

words.ex: He drinks coffee at a small cafe.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小咖啡馆喝咖啡。
words.en: A cafe is a small restaurant where drinks and snacks are sold.

words.tr: n. 清洁；打扫； v. 打扫；“clean”的现在分词；
words.ex: The cleaning of the room took an hour.
words.ex_cn: 打扫房间花了一个小时。
words.en: The act of making something clean, especially the inside of a house or building.

words.ex: Please leave your coat in the cloakroom.
words.ex_cn: 请把你的外套放在衣帽间。
words.en: A cloakroom is a room where coats, hats, luggage, or other items may be left temporarily, as in a theater, public building, or school.

words.ex: They meet at the clubhouse every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他们每星期六在会所见面。
words.en: A clubhouse is a building used by members of a particular club, especially a sports club, for socializing, changing clothes, etc.

words.tr: n. 通勤者；经常往返者；
words.ex: He is a commuter who takes the train to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名每天乘火车上班的通勤者。
words.en: A commuter is someone who travels a long distance to work every day.

words.tr:
n. 市中心区；商业区；
adv. 在市区；往市区；
words.ex: We went downtown to buy some clothes.
words.ex_cn: 我们去市中心买了一些衣服。
words.en: Downtown refers to the central part or main business and commercial area of a city or town.

words.tr: n. 穿衣； v. “dress”的现在分词；
words.ex: Every morning, she makes a quick dressing before leaving home.
words.ex_cn: 每天早上，她出门前都会快速穿衣。
words.en: A dressing is a sauce, especially one consisting of oil and vinegar mixed together with herbs or other flavorings, which you put on salad or other foods.

words.ex: He took the elevator to the 10th floor.
words.ex_cn: 他乘电梯上了十楼。
words.en: An elevator is a device that moves people or goods up and down inside a building.

words.ex: He collected firewood for the campfire.
words.ex_cn: 他为篝火收集了木柴。
words.en: Wood that is cut and used for fuel in fires.

words.ex: Children walk on the footpath to school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在人行道上步行去学校。
words.en: A footpath is a path that is designed for people to walk along, especially one in the countryside or a park.

words.ex: The store sells all kinds of footwear.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种鞋类。
words.en: Footwear refers to garments worn on the feet, which typically serve the purpose of protection against adversities of the environment such as ground textures and temperature.

words.ex: Farmers grow tomatoes in a greenhouse.
words.ex_cn: 农民在温室里种植番茄。
words.en: A greenhouse is a building with glass walls and roof; for the cultivation and exhibition of plants under controlled conditions.

words.ex: He buys milk and bread at the grocery.
words.ex_cn: 他在杂货店买牛奶和面包。
words.en: A grocery is a store where food and small items for the house are sold.

words.tr: n. （有锁的）寄物柜；锁柜；上锁的人
words.ex: He put his books in the locker.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在储物柜里。
words.en: A locker is a small storage compartment, typically in a public place such as a school, gym, or workplace, where individuals can store their personal belongings securely.

words.ex: He puts his sandwich in a lunchbox.
words.ex_cn: 他把三明治放进午餐盒里。
words.en: A lunchbox is a small container used to carry food, typically for lunch, to school or work.

words.ex: He does meditation every morning to relax.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上冥想以放松。
words.en: Meditation is the act of remaining in a silent and calm state for a period of time, as part of a religious training, or so that you are more able to deal with the problems of everyday life.

words.ex: She heated the food in the microwave.
words.ex_cn: 她把食物放在微波炉里加热。
words.en: A microwave is a type of oven that cooks or heats food very quickly by using electromagnetic waves rather than heat.

words.ex: They stayed at a motel near the highway.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在高速公路旁的一家汽车旅馆。
words.en: A motel is a hotel which is designed for people who are travelling by car, usually with parking spaces next to each room.

words.ex: She walks with a pushchair in the park.
words.ex_cn: 她推着婴儿车在公园里散步。
words.en: A pushchair is a small folding chair on wheels, in which a baby or small child can be pushed along.

words.ex: The radiator is hot in the winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天时，散热器是热的。
words.en: A radiator is a device for heating a room or building, consisting of a series of pipes through which hot water or steam is circulated. It can also refer to a device for cooling an engine or other mechanism, typically consisting of a bank of thin tubes with fins attached, through which coolant flows.

words.tr:
n. 长袍
v. （使）穿上长袍
words.ex: He puts on a white robe after the shower.
words.ex_cn: 他洗完澡后穿上一件白袍。
words.en: A robe is a long, loose piece of clothing that covers all of your body and reaches the ground. It is often worn for ceremonies or in the home.

words.tr: n. 座位安排；供给座位； v. “seat”的现在分词；
words.ex: The theater improved its seating for better comfort.
words.ex_cn: 剧院改进了座位安排以提升舒适度。
words.en: The arrangement of seats in a place, or the provision of seats for people to sit on.

words.ex: The shopper bought apples at the market.
words.ex_cn: 这位购物者在市场买了苹果。
words.en: A shopper is a person who is shopping or who is looking to buy goods from stores.

words.ex: He cooks soup on the stove.
words.ex_cn: 他用炉子煮汤。
words.en: A stove is a piece of equipment which provides heat, either for cooking or for heating a room.

words.tr:
n. 真空；空虚；
v. 用真空吸尘器打扫；
words.ex: The vacuum in space keeps no air.
words.ex_cn: 太空中的真空没有空气。
words.en: A vacuum is a space that contains no air or other gas, or a space from which most of the air or gas has been removed. It can also refer to a device that cleans floors and surfaces by sucking up dirt and dust.

words.ex: He used a voucher to buy a coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他用一张代金券买了一杯咖啡。
words.en: A voucher is a piece of paper that can be used instead of money to pay for something, or that allows you to pay less than the usual price for something.

words.ex: He wore a white waistcoat with his suit.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着一件白色背心搭配西装。
words.en: A waistcoat is a sleeveless garment that buttons down the front, typically worn over a shirt and under a jacket as part of a man's formal or business attire.

words.tr: n. 要洗的衣物；洗好的衣物； v. 洗；洗涤；“wash”的现在分词；
words.ex: She put the washing into the machine.
words.ex_cn: 她把要洗的衣物放进洗衣机里。
words.en: The act of cleaning something using water and usually soap or detergent.

words.tr: n. 住处；膳宿；(交通工具内的)空间；
words.ex: The hotel provided cheap accommodation for travelers.
words.ex_cn: 酒店为旅客提供了便宜的住处。
words.en: Accommodation is a place where someone lives or stays, or the act of providing someone with a place to live or stay.

words.ex: He carries his books in a backpack.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在背包里。
words.en: A backpack is a bag with straps that go over your shoulders, so that you can carry things on your back.

words.ex: He filled the bucket with water from the well.
words.ex_cn: 他从井里打了一桶水。
words.en: A bucket is a round container with a handle, used for carrying liquids or other substances.

words.ex: He made a box from cardboard.
words.ex_cn: 他用纸板做了一个盒子。
words.en: Cardboard is a stiff, heavy paper material that is used for making boxes and other packaging.

words.ex: She put the apples in a plastic container.
words.ex_cn: 她把苹果放进了一个塑料容器里。
words.en: A container is something such as a box or bottle that is used to hold or store things in.

words.ex: The store is open 24 hours for your convenience.
words.ex_cn: 商店24小时营业，以方便您。
words.en: The state of being able to proceed with something with little effort or difficulty.

words.ex: The small room was cosy with a warm blanket and a cup of tea.
words.ex_cn: 这个小房间铺着温暖的毯子，喝着热茶，非常舒适。
words.en: A place or situation that is cosy is comfortable and warm.

words.ex: She placed the cutlery neatly on the table.
words.ex_cn: 她把餐具整齐地放在桌子上。
words.en: Cutlery refers to the tools used for eating or serving food, such as knives, forks, and spoons.

words.ex: The worker wore a mask to avoid breathing in dust.
words.ex_cn: 这位工人戴上口罩以避免吸入粉尘。
words.en: Dust is a layer of fine, dry particles on the surface of something, or the fine, dry particles themselves.

words.ex: She bought a new garment for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一件新衣服。
words.en: A garment is a piece of clothing; used especially in contexts where you are talking about the manufacture or sale of clothes.

words.ex: She uses a hairdryer every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上都用吹风机。
words.en: A hairdryer is an electrical device used to blow warm or hot air over wet hair to speed up the evaporation of water and dry the hair.

words.ex: A pocket calculator is handy for math problems.
words.ex_cn: 便携式计算器对于数学问题很方便。
words.en: If something is handy, it is useful and easy to use or to reach.

words.tr: n. （校外）学生宿舍；旅社；招待所；
words.ex: The students live in a cheap hostel near the university.
words.ex_cn: 学生们住在大学附近的一家便宜的学生宿舍里。
words.en: A hostel is a budget-oriented, shared-room accommodation that attracts a diverse clientele, including backpackers, students, and travelers seeking an economical place to stay.

words.tr: n. 废旧杂物；无价值的东西；
words.ex: He cleaned up the junk in his garage.
words.ex_cn: 他清理了车库里那些废旧杂物。
words.en: Old or discarded articles that are considered useless or of little value.

words.ex: He turned the knob to adjust the volume.
words.ex_cn: 他转动旋钮来调节音量。
words.en: A knob is a round handle, or a round switch on a piece of equipment.

words.ex: He tied a knot in the rope.
words.ex_cn: 他在绳子上打了一个结。
words.en: A knot is a fastening made by tying a piece of string, rope, or something similar. It can also refer to a hard mass formed in a tree trunk at the intersection with a branch, or a unit of speed equal to one nautical mile per hour, used especially by ships and aircraft.

words.ex: He lives a 24/7 lifestyle, working and texting all day and night.
words.ex_cn: 他过着24/7的生活方式，整天整夜地工作和发信息。
words.en: The way in which a person lives is their lifestyle.

words.tr: n. 奢华；奢侈品；难得的享受；
words.ex: She bought a luxury dress for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一件奢华的裙子。
words.en: Luxury is very great comfort, especially among beautiful and expensive surroundings.

words.tr:
n. 东西；原料；
v. 塞；填充；
words.ex: I need to clean up all this stuff.
words.ex_cn: 我需要清理这些东西。
words.en: If you stuff something somewhere, you push it there quickly and roughly. If you stuff a container or space with something, you fill it completely with that thing.

words.ex: This jacket is waterproof.
words.ex_cn: 这件夹克是防水的。
words.en: Something that is waterproof does not let water pass through it.

words.ex: He sat on a wooden chair.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在一张木制椅子上。
words.en: Made of wood; lacking ease or grace.

words.ex: She knits a sweater from wool.
words.ex_cn: 她用羊毛织毛衣。
words.en: Wool is the hair that grows on sheep and some other animals, which is used to make clothes, blankets, etc.

words.ex: The agency helps people find jobs.
words.ex_cn: 这个机构帮助人们找工作。
words.en: An agency is a business which provides a service on behalf of other businesses.

words.ex: The boss appointed Tom as the new manager.
words.ex_cn: 老板任命汤姆为新经理。
words.en: If you appoint someone to a job or official position, you formally choose them for it.

words.ex: I have an appointment with my doctor at 3 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我下午三点有个医生的约会。
words.en: An appointment is a formal arrangement to meet or visit someone at a particular time, especially for a purpose connected with their work or official position.

words.ex: He built a successful career in medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他在医学领域建立了成功的事业。
words.en: A career is the job or series of jobs that you do during your working life, especially if you continue to get better jobs and earn more money.

words.ex: The lawyer helped her client with the contract.
words.ex_cn: 律师帮助她的客户处理合同。
words.en: A client is a person or organization receiving services or advice from a professional or company.

words.ex: The committee meets every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 委员会每周一开会。
words.en: A committee is a group of people who are chosen to do a particular job or make decisions on behalf of a larger group.

words.tr: n. 全体船员；全体人员；
words.ex: The crew fixed the ship's engine during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 全体船员在风暴中修好了船的引擎。
words.en: A crew is a group of people who work on and operate a ship, aircraft, or train.

words.ex: He finished his homework before the deadline.
words.ex_cn: 他在截止日期前完成了作业。
words.en: A deadline is a time or date before which a particular task must be finished or a particular thing must be done.

words.ex: He found employment after graduating from university.
words.ex_cn: 他大学毕业后找到了工作。
words.en: the condition of having paid work

words.tr: n. 农事；耕作；养殖； v. 务农；“farm”的现在分词；
words.ex: Farming is hard work in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 农事在乡村是很辛苦的工作。
words.en: Farming is the activity of growing crops or keeping animals on a farm.

words.ex: The city has many industrial factories.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市有许多工业工厂。
words.en: Industrial means relating to or characterized by industry.

words.ex: Good management helps a company grow.
words.ex_cn: 良好的管理有助于公司发展。
words.en: The control and organization of something, especially a business and its employees.

words.tr:
n. 制造；
v. （用机器大量）制造；虚构；捏造；
words.ex: The manufacture of cars needs many workers.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的制造需要很多工人。
words.en: To manufacture something means to make it in a factory, usually in large quantities.

words.tr: n. 制造业； v. 制造；“manufacture”的现在分词；
words.ex: Manufacturing is important for the country's economy.
words.ex_cn: 制造业对国家经济很重要。
words.en: The process of converting raw materials into finished products, especially by means of a large-scale industrial operation.

words.ex: The organization helps poor children.
words.ex_cn: 这个组织帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: An organization is a group of people who work together in a structured way for a shared purpose.

words.ex: Free lunch is a perk of this job.
words.ex_cn: 免费午餐是这份工作的一个额外补贴。
words.en: If someone perks up or if something perks them up, they become more cheerful or lively.

words.ex: His profession is a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他的职业是教师。
words.en: A profession is a type of job that requires advanced education or training.

words.ex: The company plans to recruit new staff next month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司计划下个月招聘新员工。
words.en: To recruit means to enlist someone in the armed forces or to persuade someone to join a company, organization, or group.

words.ex: Please remove the trash from the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 请把厨房的垃圾去掉。
words.en: To take something or someone away from a place or off a surface.

words.ex: He took responsibility for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他承担了这个错误的责任。
words.en: If you have responsibility for something or someone, or if they are your responsibility, it is your job or duty to deal with them and to take decisions relating to them.

words.ex: He will retire next year.
words.ex_cn: 他明年将退休。
words.en: If you retire, you stop working, usually because you have reached a certain age or because you are ill.

words.tr: adj. 已退休的；已退职的； v. 退休；“retire”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: My retired grandfather walks in the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我已退休的爷爷每天早上都在公园散步。
words.en: Having left one's job and ceased to work.

words.ex: He plans to start his retirement next year.
words.ex_cn: 他计划明年退休。
words.en: Retirement is the period of one's life after leaving one's job and ceasing to work.

words.tr:
adj. 资深的；高级的；年长的；
n. 年长者；大四学生；
words.ex: He is a senior engineer with 20 years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有20年经验的资深工程师。
words.en: Higher in rank, status, or importance; older in age.

words.ex: The staff at the hotel are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的职员非常友好。
words.en: The people who work for a particular organization or company, or a group of officers assisting a commanding officer.

words.tr: adj. 失业的；待业的；下岗的；
words.ex: He is unemployed after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业了，因为失去了工作。
words.en: If someone is unemployed, they do not have a job.

words.tr: n. 工作场所；工作地点；
words.ex: The new safety rules apply to the workplace.
words.ex_cn: 新的安全规则适用于工作场所。
words.en: A workplace is a place where people work, such as an office or factory.

words.tr:
n. 输出；出口；
v. 输出；出口；
words.ex: This country is a big export of wheat.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家是小麦的大输出国。
words.en: To send goods to another country for sale.

words.ex: He got a teaching qualification last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年获得了教师资格。
words.en: A qualification is a skill or type of experience that you need in order to do a particular job or activity.

words.tr: n. 理事会；委员会；议会；
words.ex: The city council made a new rule about recycling.
words.ex_cn: 市政府理事会制定了关于回收的新规定。
words.en: A council is a group of people who are elected to govern a local area such as a city or, in Britain, a county.

words.tr:
v. 建造；构造；
n. 概念；
words.ex: They construct houses with bricks.
words.ex_cn: 他们用砖块建造房屋。
words.en: To construct something means to build or create it, usually something large such as a building, road, or machine.

words.tr: v. 兑现；递送；交付；发表；为…接生；
words.ex: He promised to deliver on his goal.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺要兑现自己的目标。
words.en: To bring and hand over (a letter, parcel, or ordered goods) to the proper recipient or address.

words.ex: The delivery of the package took three days.
words.ex_cn: 这个包裹的交付花了三天时间。
words.en: The act of delivering letters, parcels, or goods.

words.ex: He invests money in stocks.
words.ex_cn: 他投资股票。
words.en: If you invest in something, or if you invest a sum of money, you use your money in a way that you hope will increase its value, for example by putting it in a bank, or buying shares or property.

words.ex: The cost of maintenance is low for this car.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的维持费用很低。
words.en: The process of preserving a condition or situation or the state of being preserved.

words.ex: The teacher monitors the students' progress each week.
words.ex_cn: 老师每周监控学生的进步。
words.en: A monitor is a machine that is used to check or record things, for example in a factory or hospital. In a school, a monitor is a student who helps the teacher with various duties.

words.ex: The teacher supervises the students during the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 老师在实验期间指导学生。
words.en: If you supervise an activity or a person, you make sure that the activity is done correctly or that the person is doing a task or behaving correctly.

words.tr:
n. 利润；
v. 获利；
words.ex: The company made a big profit this year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司今年赚了大量利润。
words.en: Profit is the amount of money that you gain when you are paid more for something than it cost you to make, get, or do it.

words.tr:
n. 赞助商；
v. 赞助；
words.ex: The company is a sponsor of the football match.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司是这场足球赛的赞助商。
words.en: A sponsor is a person or organization that pays for or contributes to the costs involved in staging a sporting or artistic event in return for advertising. A sponsor can also be someone who introduces and supports a proposal for a new law.

words.tr:
n. 税；税款；
v. 对...征税；
words.ex: He pays tax every year.
words.ex_cn: 他每年缴税。
words.en: A tax is a sum of money that you have to pay to the government so that it can pay for public services.

words.tr: n. 营业额；人员流动率；周转率；
words.ex: The store's turnover increased last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店上个月的营业额增加了。
words.en: The amount of money taken by a business in a particular period.

words.ex: The case will be heard in court next week.
words.ex_cn: 这个案件将于下周在法院审理。
words.en: A court is a place where legal matters are decided by a judge and jury or by a magistrate.

words.ex: The police caught the man for a serious crime.
words.ex_cn: 警察抓住了那个犯下严重罪行的人。
words.en: A crime is an illegal action or activity for which a person can be punished by law.

words.ex: He hired a legal lawyer to help him.
words.ex_cn: 他请了一位法律律师来帮助他。
words.en: Relating to the law or to lawyers, or permitted or required by law.

words.ex: The new legislation bans plastic bags.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法规禁止使用塑料袋。
words.en: Legislation refers to the process of making or enacting laws by a government or other authority.

words.ex: I suspect it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我猜想明天会下雨。
words.en: If you suspect someone of doing something wrong or dishonest, you believe that they have done it, although you have no proof.

words.ex: The doctor ran a trial to test the new medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生进行了试验来测试这种新药。
words.en: A trial is a formal meeting in a law court, at which a judge and jury listen to evidence and decide whether a person is guilty of a crime.

words.tr:
n. 吸引力；上诉；
v. 吸引；诉请；呼吁；
words.ex: The appeal of the beach drew many tourists.
words.ex_cn: 海滩的吸引力吸引了许多游客。
words.en: If you appeal to someone to do something, you make a serious and urgent request to them. If you appeal against a decision or sentence, you formally ask a court or other authority to change it. If something appeals to you, you like it or it interests you.

words.tr:
v. 禁止；
n. 禁止；
words.ex: The school bans phones in class.
words.ex_cn: 学校禁止在课堂上使用手机。
words.en: If there is a ban on something, it is not allowed. If something is banned, it is not allowed to be done, shown, or used.

words.ex: He received a certificate for completing the course.
words.ex_cn: 他完成了课程后获得了证书。
words.en: A certificate is an official document attesting a fact, in particular.

words.tr: n. 代码；编码；行为准则；密码；法典；
words.ex: He wrote a simple code to solve the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一段简单的代码来解决这个数学问题。
words.en: A code is a system of words, letters, figures, or other symbols substituted for other words, letters, etc., especially for the purposes of secrecy. As a verb, it means to convert (a message or other information) into a code.

words.ex: The team's defence was very strong in the match.
words.ex_cn: 这支队伍在比赛中防守非常坚强。
words.en: The action of defending from or resisting attack.

words.tr:
n. 需求；要求；
v. 要求；需求；
words.ex: The demand for clean water is increasing.
words.ex_cn: 对清洁水的需求正在增加。
words.en: If you demand something, you ask for it very forcefully, often because you think you have a right to do so.

words.tr:
n. 文件；公文；文献；
v. 记录；为…提供证明；
